facts.summary: Trial discontinued after interim analysis showed no clinical benefit · Phase 2 · telaglenastat in KEAP1/NRF2-mutant NSCLC · not yet approved
facts.indication: stage IV non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer with KEAP1 or NRF2 mutation

evidence.summary: announced today the decision to terminate its phase 2 KEAPSAKE clinical trial based on a lack of clinical benefit observed in patients treated with telaglenastat in an interim analysis.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The available efficacy data at unblinding, including investigator-assessed progression-free survival (PFS), did not demonstrate clinical benefit
evidence.safety: No difference in safety profile was seen between the two arms.
evidence.program_discontinued: Calithera has no plans to continue the development of telaglenastat at this time.
